description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy (ACC) percentage of different methods as a function of the co-occurrence number. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number," is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^3. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)", ranges from 40% to 65%. The plot includes six lines representing different methods: Base (black line with circle markers), MEND (brown line with diamond markers), FT (blue line with triangle markers), MEMIT (purple line with pentagon markers), IKE (red line with square markers), and a grey area representing the base method. The Base method shows a steady increase in accuracy as the co-occurrence number increases. MEND starts at approximately 45% and increases to just over 55%. FT begins around 40% and rises to about 50%. MEMIT starts at around 45% and climbs to just under 60%. IKE begins at approximately 40% and increases to about 50%. The grey area representing the base method remains constant at around 40% across all co-occurrence numbers.
